shortDescription: 提取文档内容，按页阅读。
capabilitySummary: Reads bounded page ranges from PDF files attached through the current workspace binding.

tools.description: Extract text from a PDF in the current workspace binding. Pages are 1-indexed; each call returns up to 50 pages and 128 KiB of text from a file up to 16 MiB. Use the returned page range and truncation flags to continue with a smaller range when needed. Scanned page images require a separate visual or OCR workflow.

path.description: Workspace-relative path from an attached filesystem reference.

endPage.description: Inclusive last page. Omit to read toward the end within the per-call page and output limits.

promptContribution.promptSnippet: Read bounded page ranges from a PDF attached to the current workspace binding.
usageGuidelines: Use the logical workspace handle and workspace-relative path shown in the message's filesystem references.
Read another bounded page range when the result reports remaining pages or truncated output.
